annotation.justification: The target clause lacks a concrete constraint on the size of the datagrams that may be sent after handshake acknowledgment, leading to multiple reasonable interpretations.
annotation.missing_information: The clause should specify the reference size (e.g., smaller than 1200 bytes) or clarify the intended meaning of "smaller datagrams" relative to the padded size requirement for Initial packets. Without this, implementations may differ on what constitutes a smaller datagram after handshake acknowledgment.
